title: The Colony of Sector Nine
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Jude Vasquez, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
